Business Environment & Enterprise Performance Survey

The Business Environment & Enterprise Performance Survey (BEEPS) offers policymakers, academics, and companies’ useful information to evaluate the legal system, the business environment, the availability of capital, corruption, and innovation. The survey’s results contribute to policy discussions, encourage private sector growth, and back evidence-based changes for long-term economic expansion.

  1. Objectives: The main goal of the BEEPS survey is to deliver insightful data on the regional business climate and company performance to policymakers, researchers, and enterprises. The poll collects information on the business environment’s regulatory environment, investment climate, financial accessibility, corruption, and other variables.
  2. Coverage: The European Union, the Western Balkans, the Eastern Partnership, and Central Asia are among the regions of Europe and Central Asia that are the focus of BEEPS. Small, medium, and big firms from a variety of industries are all included in the poll.
  3. Data Collection: Business owners and managers who participated in structured interviews for BEEPS provided the data. A variety of themes are included in the survey questionnaire, such as company registration, taxation, access to financing, labor laws, infrastructure, corruption, innovation, and other areas of the business environment.
  4. Insights and Analysis: The World Bank Group, the EBRD, and other scholars can analyze the business climate and enterprise performance in participating countries thanks to the data gathered through BEEPS. The findings offer understanding into the difficulties faced by businesses, point out potential policy reform targets, and evaluate the influence of several variables on the growth of enterprises.
  5. Policy Recommendations: The findings of BEEPS are used to guide policy debates and reforms targeted at enhancing the business climate and fostering the growth of the private sector. The survey results assist policymakers in determining the areas that require reform to boost competition, lower barriers to entry for new businesses, increase access to capital, and strengthen institutional frameworks.
  6. A longitudinal examination of changes in the business environment and firm performance over time is possible thanks to BEEPS, which has been undertaken on a regular basis since 1999. With the use of this longitudinal view, researchers may monitor trends, evaluate the effects of policy actions, and pinpoint areas of development or difficulty in the corporate environment.

The Business Environment & corporate Performance Survey (BEEPS) offers insightful data on the business climate and corporate performance in Central Asia and Europe. It is a tool for creating evidence-based policies that encourage entrepreneurship and sustainable economic growth. It is used by politicians, researchers, and companies to understand better the obstacles to and possibilities for private sector development.
